entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. For sales, press one. For technical support, press two. For returns or other inquiries, please stay on the line.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return something and your website is a joke. I want to talk to someone who can actually do something. This is completely unacceptable!
I'm very sorry to hear you've had a frustrating experience, sir. I can definitely help you with a return. Can I start with your name and order number?
It's David Chen, order number VF88-1092. I bought this helmet almost two months ago and I want my money back. Now.
Thank you, David. I have your order right here. To make sure I understand correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

The issue is the color! It looked charcoal on your site, but it's practically black. It's hideous. I'm not wearing it, and if I'm not wearing it, that's a safety issue, isn't it? The box is unopened, I haven't even taken the plastic off. Just give me my refund or I swear I'll post this call everywhere. I want to speak to your manager!
I understand completely, and there's no need for a manager, David. I can handle this for you. Let me just confirm the policy for you. One moment.

Okay, I've checked. You received the item 45 days ago, which is well within our 90-day return window for standard items. Since the box is unopened, I can approve this return for a full refund immediately.
Wait, really? You're just going to approve it? I was expecting a whole song and dance.

Of course. You're well within the policy timeframe. I've just emailed a prepaid shipping label to the address on file. Please attach that to the original box and you can drop it off at any FedEx location. Once our warehouse scans it, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method.
Oh. Okay. Well... that's good. That's what you should do. Thank you.
You're very welcome, David. Was there anything else I could help you with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
